_help._file: Timings and looks shared by every lesson (F30, src/game/lessons/). Each lesson's own timings (showAfter, hint after…) are in its file in content/lessons/ — the Dev Kit's Lessons tab edits those live.
_help.dismissArmSeconds: A message that waits for 'Got it' can't be closed for this long after it appears (so a tap meant for the game doesn't close it unread). The button is there from the start; it just doesn't work yet.
_help.betweenStepsSeconds: A short breath between one step ending and the next starting.
_help.slowSpeed: How fast the game runs under a step that shows its message with "while": "slow" (1 = normal speed).
_help.gatePollMs: How often a step checks its gate (the piece's row, the pressure…), in ms.
_help.consoleNoteVisits: F32: the first this-many times a player goes to the console mid-shift (outside a lesson), one line says the tank keeps running slowly there. Counted on the device; Settings → Replay lessons starts the count again.
_help.insistSeconds: F32 (Muzzy: one go-to-console message that gets more assertive): after the machine has been broken this long (shift time — the lesson's pause doesn't count), the go-to-console message insists: the shift pauses, the dim comes on, and only the console control works (W / ↑ / flick up). 4 = the moment the visor's glitch is at full strength (visor-fx.json rampMs).
_help.dimAmount: F32: how dark the spotlight's dim is round what a lesson shows you (0 = none, 1 = black).
